title: Brooklyn Triangle Bra
description: This ultra-soft, smoothing cotton Lovemère Triangle Nursing Bra is made to brighten up your day! With its plunging neckline and elastic straps crafted by the Lovemère Team, nursing sessions are easy and hassle-free. And non-nursing women can wear it, too. It has a wire-free under-bust band for extended wear, plus adjustable thin straps, removable paddings and a lightweight finish. Enjoy five chic colors - Wild Burgundy, Saddle, Stripes, Nude and Black. Simply pull the boob out to nurse. Wire-free triangle bralette Lining 100% Cotton Main 90% Cotton 10% Elastane Adjustable thin shoulder straps Removable soft cups inserts 3 rows of hooks and eyes Elastic under-bust band Model’s cup size is 34/75B and wearing size S Wearing and Nursing Guide:To have more coverage, hook on the last row of eyes. Adjust the strap accordingly to your best comfort. Pull down the cup to the side of your boob to nurse, and pull back up. The elastic band will do all the work for you. Bra Care:Recommend to hand-wash with mild soap and hang dry with no direct sunlight.

title: Chloe Dream Love Organic Bra
description: Discover unparalleled comfort with Chloe Dream Love Organic Nursing Bra. Crafted with superior cotton, this soft, breathable, and absorbent fabric efficiently wicks away moisture to keep you dry and cozy all day and night. Its seamless crisscross design at the front effortlessly pulls back for convenient nursing; the generous coverage ensures no spillage and the racerback design offers complete support. The wide strap below the bust-line prevents chafing, while the removable paddings customize your look. Available in five dreamy hues—Cocoa, Rustic, Nude, Emerald, and Sea Glass—this bra gives you time to pause and relax.FEATURES: Inner removable padding Hand wash or machine wash with laundry net 95% Organic Cotton 5% Elastane Model is wearing S size

title: Seamless Nursing Bra
description: Exclusive to Lovemère, our ribbed design has been manually adjusted and tailored for optimal support as your bust size fluctuates through maternity and postpartum. Our seamless molded cups offer medium coverage, suitable for any outfit. Removable pads provide modesty and shape, while cushioning the sore busts and nips. Clasps at the front make nursing effortless, adjustable shoulder straps and a three-row hook and eye closure at the back ensure a comfortable and secure fit. Find the Original Seamless LM Nursing Bra in a wealth of colors, or opt for our combo packs of 2, 3, 5 and 7.FEATURES: Seamfree comfort for a beautiful comfort feel Spacer fabric provides opacity without the weight Short stretch straps for a secure support Nursing Drop clips for easy feeding Supportive wide-cut under band 4 column, 3-row hook and eye back closure One pair of removable paddings inclusive 92% Nylon, 8% Elastane Hand wash preferred. If machine wash, clasp the bra and put inside a laundry net, gentle spin away from heavyweight items like towels and fabrics with buttons and zippers

title: Savannah Maxi Dress
description: When motherhood bogs you down, you deserve to feel like the goddess that you are. And nothing better to feel good than a classic striped maxi dress. This floor length fitted dress comes with knee-high slits that make it the perfect sexy outfit. The horizontal stripes look lovely on a baby bump. The rayon and elastane blend fabric gives you a dress that is soft against the skin.The Henley neckline of the dress makes it easy to nurse by just unbuttoning till you have easy access for breastfeeding. A pair of pretty slippers and delicate jewelry, and you are good to go!FEATURES: 94% Rayon and 6% Elastane Classy black buttons for nursing Soft fabric Knee level side slits Long bottom Tank top design Pregnant model’s height is 1.7m while non-pregnant model is 1.6m. Both are wearing size “S”.

title: Twilight Plum Ribbon Dress
description: Flowy and feminine, our Twilight Plum Ribbon Dress is crafted in a soft, breathable 95% rayon and 5% elastane blend that drapes beautifully on your changing body. With an above-the-knee length and an attached ribbon you can tie at the front or back, this dress is playful, polished, and made for real mom-life.The Twilight Plum colour is a rich blend of dark red and deep purple, like the sky just after sunset. It's warm, grounding, and universally flattering. There's something about this shade that feels calm and collected, helping you feel relaxed and put together even on the busiest days. Hidden nursing access is tucked inside: simply pull out the inner panel to feed, then tuck it back when you're done. Easy and discreet. Side pockets keep your hands free, because mums need this. Pair it with sneakers for errands, light sandals for brunch, or throw on a sling bag and you're out the door. From pregnancy to breastfeeding to postpartum, this little ribbon dress goes all the way with you.FEATURES: Details Above the knee-length cut Inner nursing panels Attached ribbon Side pockets 95% Cotton, 5% Elastane Care Hand wash in cool water with mild detergent for first wash. After that, gentle machine wash in cool water with like colours. Hang dry and steam iron on low heat.
